animal: a fluffy brown sea otter with thick fur, white whiskers and small round ears
headline: 해달 미용실 원장
오늘 손님도 해달

lines.say: 오후 세 시. 해달 미용실에 첫 손님이 들어온다.
lines.img: a bright cozy salon interior with a chair and a big plain mirror, a sea otter customer sitting in the chair and a fluffy brown sea otter with thick fur, white whiskers and small round ears as the stylist standing behind it, plain white walls, soft daylight

a close view of a fluffy brown sea otter with thick fur, white whiskers and small round ears running a small plain comb through thick dense fluffy brown fur of a customer sea otter, bright salon, plain white walls

a fluffy brown sea otter with thick fur, white whiskers and small round ears holding a plain comb up to the light looking thoughtful, next to a chair with a very fluffy sea otter customer, plain white walls

lines.say: 원장은 빗을 든 채 한참 동안 멈춰 있다.
lines.img: a fluffy brown sea otter with thick fur, white whiskers and small round ears standing frozen holding a plain comb above the huge fluffy fur of a customer sea otter, a tall pile of fur around them, bright salon, plain white walls

a sea otter customer with perfectly fluffy dry fur smiling in a plain mirror, a fluffy brown sea otter with thick fur, white whiskers and small round ears waving goodbye at a plain door, warm golden light

caption: 원장님 그냥 드라이만 하시는 거 맞죠
